purpose: Teach: カントリー/水戸/阪急/ダイエー/那覇/ホワイトハウス/ジョンソン/ブレア

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがカントリーミュージックを聴かせて下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your father says he's going to play country music for you.
lines.style: Warm, gently conspiratorial tone. Speaking to Sho with affection but also directing the moment. Soft opening, unhurried. A small smile in the voice — she's sharing good news.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと水戸の博物館行きたいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want to go to the Mito Museum with Dad!
lines.style: Bright, animated opening attack. Quick pace, rising energy. Excitement barely contained. The happiness of a child who's been thinking about this and can't wait to share it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが阪急電車に乗せて下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your father says he'll take you on the Hankyu train.
lines.style: Gentle, knowing tone. Slightly slower pace than before — she's savoring his delight. Tender delivery, as if offering a small treasure. Slight warm trailing-off.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとダイエー跡地の話聞いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad told me about the old Daiei site!
lines.style: Quick, bright delivery with rising energy at the word 'Daiei'. Genuine excitement — he's been listening and learning. Small, unforced laugh quality. The eagerness of wanting to share what he knows.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが那覇に出張されるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your father will be traveling to Naha on business.
lines.style: Calm, informative delivery. Slightly more measured than the previous lines. Not sad, but grounded — sharing news that shifts the dynamic. Quiet respect in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとホワイトハウスのドキュメンタリー観たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I watched a documentary about the White House!
lines.style: Urgent, proud energy. Quick words tumbling out. The brightness of a child who has shared something with his father and is bursting to tell her. Warm excitement, not performed.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがジョンソン元大統領の本を貸して下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your father is lending you a book about former President Johnson.
lines.style: Pleased, almost conspiratorial warmth. Slow, deliberate pacing — this is a gift, and she knows it means something. Quiet delight that he's being trusted with something grown-up.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとブレア元首相のドキュメンタリー観たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I watched a documentary about former Prime Minister Blair!
lines.style: Peak excitement. Words rush forward, almost breathless. The warmth and closeness of a child who has shared learning time with his father and wants her to know everything. Trailing energy upward.
